recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration issue additional guidance reminding entities of the need to review the renewal of appointments carefully in the current context, so as to ensure that all contract renewals undergo prudent review and are supported by sufficient justifications, particularly in the context of workforce restructuring and financial constraints.
